decisions.statement: Which page types declare a property is one read beside that property's page.
A page type declaring a property carries the property to every type beneath that page type.
Descent is read from the reverse of `extends-type` rather than from a page type's body.
A property declared as a record's field is carried by the types with that record.
A property nested deeper than one record is not reached.
A page type carrying a property is answered whether or not a page of it is there.
A name no page property has is answered with no page type rather than refusing.
No page under a page type is read here.

definition: the page types declaring a page property, and the types beneath each of them
